title: Tent Stakes 8-Pack – Heavy-Duty Ground Stakes
descriptionHtml:
The tent that stays put – even when it's windy

Thin tent stakes bend easily and come loose in hard ground or wind. Then you're standing there in the middle of the night trying to secure the tent again.

Heavy-duty stakes that hold

These tent stakes are made of heavy-duty metal that withstands hard ground. They hold firmly and keep tents and tarps in place even when it's windy.

Features

  • 8 heavy-duty metal ground stakes
  • Withstands hard and rocky ground
  • Holds firmly even in wind
  • For tents, tarps and windbreaks
  • Easy to pack and take along

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
